text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there... Ehehe, did you hear 
that just now?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then you might as well listen to my story! 
So get this, McQueen, right...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The secret to long distances is keeping a 
steady pace in everything. Why don't you 
try tempo running too, Teio-san?" ...she 
told me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, tempo running is way too slow! 
Running full blast feels so much better!
choice_data_list:
The method that suits you best is number 
one!

Running feels even better after holding it 
in.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, totally! Totally! Training 
that gets you pumped up is always the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna go run one lap at top 
speed! Here I go! I'm the strongest ever!

She seems to focus better when doing the 
training routine she chose herself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Maybe that's it! After doing a 
tempo run, go into a full-on sprint!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That definitely sounds so much nicer than 
just running! Hehe, good to know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll keep up the tempo runs just a 
bit longer. Thanks for talking it through 
with me!
